subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay image media from unmentioned requireMention group messages into a later mentioned turn, and under what default bounds?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but it changes a privacy/security boundary by storing media that did not mention the bot and later exposing it to model context.

options.title: Approve bounded history media
options.body: Retain a small image-only, historyLimit-bounded set of allowed unmentioned group media and replay it only after the same group/thread visibility checks pass.

options.title: Keep current privacy default
options.body: Continue skipping unaddressed group media before download and document that later mentions can only use text history unless the message addressed the bot.

options.title: Make retention explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a per-group or per-topic setting before retaining unmentioned group media for later model context.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded history media
recommendation.body: Retain a small image-only, historyLimit-bounded set of allowed unmentioned group media and replay it only after the same group/thread visibility checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The current no-mention media skip behavior this decision must preserve or narrow came from joshavant's related Telegram media-gating work.
